Article 3

Definitions

For the purposes of this Regulation, the following definitions apply:

(1)

‘AI system’ means a machine-based system;

(14)

‘safety component’ means a component of a product (1);

(1) A footnote that is not part of any provision.

Article 5

Prohibited AI practices

1. The following AI practices shall be prohibited:

(a)

the use of an AI system that deploys subliminal techniques;

(c)

social scoring leading to either or both of the following:

(i)

detrimental treatment in unrelated social contexts;

2. The use of those systems shall be authorised.

Article 43

Conformity assessment

1. The provider shall opt for one of the following procedures:

(a)

internal control;

The provider shall follow Annex VII where:

(a)

harmonised standards do not exist;
